Toggle.Name: Toggle movement highlight
Toggle.Hint: Show or hide reachable squares for the controlled token.

normalColor.Name: Normal movement color
normalColor.Hint: Hex color used to tint squares within the creature's normal movement budget.

dashColor.Name: Dash movement color
dashColor.Hint: Hex color used to tint squares that require a Dash action to reach.

highlightAlpha.Name: Highlight opacity
highlightAlpha.Hint: Alpha value (0-1) applied to the movement highlights. Lower values are more transparent.

multiMode.Name: Multiple token mode
multiMode.Hint: Highlight either the first controlled token or every controlled token.

cellLimit.Name: Cell exploration limit
cellLimit.Hint: Maximum number of grid cells to explore when searching for reachable positions. Higher values may impact performance.

Notifications.NoToken: No controlled token to measure movement for.
Notifications.Gridless: Gridless scenes are not supported for movement highlighting.
Notifications.NoSpeed: The selected token has no movement speed configured.
Notifications.LimitReached: Cell exploration limit reached before exhausting the dash distance. Results may be incomplete.
